jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_furnace: 150% speed (200% with Fast Coal) and a 10% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.iron_fast_furnace: 200% speed (250% with Fast Coal) and a 15% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.gold_fast_furnace: 250% speed (300% with Fast Coal) and a 20% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.diamond_fast_furnace: 300% speed (350% with Fast Coal) and a 25% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_cobblestone: Mine stone with a correct tool and no Silk Touch: 10% chance of a bonus alongside normal drops, +5% per Fortune level. Also drops itself when mined with a pickaxe.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_coal: Mine coal ore or deepslate coal ore with a correct tool and no Silk Touch: 10% chance of a bonus alongside normal drops, +5% per Fortune level. Burns like coal normally; in Fast Furnaces, lasts 50–125% longer and adds 50 percentage points to speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_coal_block: Craft 9 Fast Coal into this block and unpack it back into 9. Burns like a coal block normally; receives Fast Coal bonuses in Fast Furnaces.
